transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. As a reminder, the current draft package has three cameras, archive reuse rights, a sponsor product display on stage, and a general caption feed. Before I sign off, I need each of you — technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — to report your final operating requirements. Who'd like to go first?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical requirement before we lock anything. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms only — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights restriction before we lock anything. The signed performance license I received this morning permits the gala broadcast, but it explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits any later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision for archive reuse rights, since archive reuse would constitute a use beyond the broadcast. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but I'm disclosing it now so it can be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical talent requirement before we lock anything. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision for a sponsor product display on stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not yet reflected in the production schedule. I'm disclosing this now so it can be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we lock anything. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for this. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. I'm disclosing this now so it can be reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
